register_acc_op_with_properties: use the register_acc_op_properties decorator to attach pointwise or unary properties to an acc_op function
add_optimization_properties_to_graphmodu: call add_optimization_properties_to_meta on a torch.fx GraphModule to annotate each node with its acc_op properties
query_acc_op_properties_registry: inspect the acc_op_properties defaultdict to look up which properties are registered for a given callable
lookup_ops_by_property: query acc_ops_with_property to find all registered ops that have a specific AccOpProperty like pointwise
define_custom_acc_op_property: extend the AccOpProperty Flag enum to define new static properties for acc_ops such as quantized
